mechanism: Lisdexamfetamine (a sympathomimetic stimulant) combined with hydroxychloroquine may increase risk of cardiac arrhythmias and QT prolongation, as hydroxychloroquine has known QT-prolonging effects and amphetamines increase cardiovascular stress.
action: Monitor cardiac function including ECG baseline and periodic assessment; use lowest effective stimulant dose; counsel patient on palpitations, chest pain, or syncope symptoms; consider alternative ADHD therapy if cardiac risk factors present.
